component.name: Gall
component.summary: Keyboard-first file manager with instant search and compare

description.p: Gall is a fast file manager for people who live on the keyboard. It pairs Miller columns with two side-by-side browsers and tabs, and adds instant search over the whole computer, a built-in compare tool and Vim keys.

ul.li: Find any file on the computer as you type (fuzzy, fzf-style syntax) and search text inside files with the ripgrep engine
Compare text and code, Excel, ODS and CSV files cell by cell, images (swipe, onion skin, pixel difference) and whole folders
Undo copy, move, rename, batch rename and delete with Ctrl+Z; a background task queue shows progress and time left
Vim keys, a which-key command menu on Space and rebindable shortcuts
Previews for images, PDF, video, audio, STL 3D models, text, code and Markdown; zip, 7z and tar archives open like folders
A Git workspace with a history graph, line-by-line staging, commits, branches, stashes, interactive rebase and a conflict editor
Git status in the file list, folder sizes, colour tags, notes and file templates
Dark and light themes, Nerd Font icons and custom CSS themes (Catppuccin and Gruvbox included)
